race.title: EASYFIX Equine Handicap Chase (Listed)
race.verdict: WINGMEN showed good resolution to rally and lead close home at Navan a fortnight ago and is fancied to follow up back in handicap company. Western Diego is feared most returned to this venue having been placed in this race last year before landing a valuable C&D handicap, while Raffles Dolce Vita and Moudan are also respected. WINGMEN (IRE) WESTERN DIEGO (IRE) RAFFLES DOLCE VITA (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Wingmen (4/1), Moudan (5/1), Jazzy Matty (6/1), Birdie Or Bust (6/1), Raffles Dolce Vita (13/2), Western Diego (10/1), Coral River (10/1), Dee Capo (12/1), Manoir De Mirande (12/1), Springt De La Mare (12/1), Drumgill (20/1), The King Of Prs (25/1)
